correctness.rationale: Repaired claim only. The original two-component calculation is correct for its literal four displayed identities, but the assertion that these are the cited LSDA identities is false. In their fourth identity the first term is x⊢(y⊢z), not x⊢(y⊣z). The distinction is structural: e1⊢e1=e2, e1⊢e2=e3, all other products zero, satisfies the published identities and is nilpotent, but fails the altered one already at (e1,e1,e1). The corrected package proves three components of dimensions 10,9,8 for the published identities and identifies the two-component locus with the extra identity x⊢(y⊣z)=x⊢(y⊢z). For the corrected proof, declining product spans and nilpotency force a unique complete flag when S³ is nonzero and force the line S³ to annihilate on either side. Evaluation of the third and fourth identities gives aj=bj=ah=(a−b)h=0 for the two e2-square coefficients j,h, hence S⁴=0. On the remaining e1-only triple the published form gives (a−b)c=(a−b)f=0 and a(c−ℓ)+(b−a)d=0. These split the intrinsic-flag fibers into the equal branch (dimension six) and the unequal branch (dimension five, with c=f=0, ℓ≠0 and d=aℓ/(b−a)). Locally trivial flag charts add three dimensions. Neither resulting closure contains the other: dimensions exclude one containment and the additional identity excludes the other. The rank-at-most-one two-step locus is the dimension-ten proper incidence image of a rank-eight bundle over the projective plane; the rank-two two-step orbit lies in the equal-branch closure via the explicit polynomial degeneration. All strata and counts persist in every characteristic. The repaired all-q formula adds P(q+1)q³(q−1)², P=q²+q+1, for the unequal branch. The repaired exact checker includes the formerly preset e2-square slots and independently evaluates both fourth-identity variants: fixed-flag counts (28,8) at q=2 and (468,108) at q=3; corrected totals 2584 and 115857 versus the frozen 2416 and 110241.
residual_risks: The replay is a fixed-flag enumeration at two prime orders, not an all-q computation or proof of irreducibility. The arbitrary-characteristic deductions are supplied algebraically. The claim is about the reduced variety only.

Finding a whole dimension-eight component rather than a single misclassified orbit changes both the geometry and arithmetic. The intrinsic extra-identity locus explains exactly how the two-component and three-component answers are related, and the all-field labelled count provides a concrete invariant beyond orbit classifications.
